name: vue-cursor
title: Vue Cursor
author: Alexey Murz Korepov
description: An oversized Vue 3 cursor with curved motion, follow mode, replaceable SVG shapes, and click animation.

withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    stroke?: string
    fill?: string
    strokeWidth?: number | string
    pressed?: boolean
    button?: 'left' | 'right' | null
  }>(),
  {
    stroke: '#111111',
    fill: '#ffffff',
    strokeWidth: 2,
    pressed: false,
    button: null,
  },

  <svg
    class="vue-cursor-shape vue-cursor-shape--arrow"
    viewBox="0 0 32 32"
    xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
    aria-hidden="true"
    :data-pressed="pressed ? 'true' : 'false'"
    :data-button="button ?? undefined"
    :style="{ transform: pressed ? 'scale(0.92)' : undefined }"
  >
    <!-- Classic arrow pointer with stem; tip at top-left -->
    <path
      d="M4 2 L4 24 L11 18 L16 28 L20 26 L15 16 L24 16 Z"
      :fill="fill"
      :stroke="stroke"
      :stroke-width="strokeWidth"
      stroke-linejoin="round"
      stroke-linecap="round"

</template>

<style scoped>
.vue-cursor-shape {
  display: block;

  height: 100%;
  overflow: visible;
  transition: transform 80ms ease-out;
}

import type { ShapeName } from '../types'

import PointerCursor from './PointerCursor.vue'
import HandCursor from './HandCursor.vue'
import type { Component } from 'vue'

export const SHAPE_COMPONENTS: Record<ShapeName, Component> = {
  arrow: ArrowCursor,
  pointer: PointerCursor,
  hand: HandCursor,
}

/** Default hotspot as fractions of the shape box (origin top-left). */
export const SHAPE_HOTSPOTS: Record<ShapeName, { x: number; y: number }> = {
  arrow: { x: 0.12, y: 0.06 },
  pointer: { x: 0.1, y: 0.06 },
